items.title: Liverpool come from behind to beat NINE-man Brentford
items.description: Highlights from the Premier League match between Brentford and Liverpool.

items.title: Man City continue to weather storm as Haaland scores twice in Ipswich win
items.description: Premier League leaders Manchester City earned a seventh straight win by beating Ipswich Town 3-2 as their on-pitch resistance showed no signs of slowing.

items.title: West Ham win at Championship leaders Swansea
items.description: West Ham ended Swansea's four-match winning streak with a 1-0 away success that reduced the gap at the top of the Sky Bet Championship to a single point.

items.title: Wrexham thump four past dismal Preston
items.description: Wrexham eased the pressure on Phil Parkinson with a 4-1 Sky Bet Championship win over rock-bottom Preston.

items.title: Sheff Utd battle to narrow win at Bristol City
items.description: Oliver Arblaster's early strike and a strong defensive display saw Sheffield United take all three points from a 1-0 Championship victory over Bristol City at Ashton Gate.

items.title: West Brom hit back to beat Blackburn in five-goal thriller
items.description: West Brom completed a stunning comeback after conceding two early goals as they beat Blackburn 3-2 in the Sky Bet Championship.

items.title: Southampton frustrated at home by Bolton
items.description: James Bree, Lewis Dobbin and Leo Scienza all squandered chances as Southampton dropped points at home for the first time this season with a 0-0 draw against Bolton.

items.title: Millar double fires Birmingham past QPR
items.description: Liam Millar scored twice as Birmingham won a crucial Sky Bet Championship clash 3-0 with QPR at St Andrew's.

items.title: Isak clinches win for Liverpool over nine-man Brentford
items.description: Alexander Isak scored on his return from injury as Liverpool fought back from a goal down to clinch a 2-1 victory over Brentford, who had Yehor Yarmoliuk and Vitaly Janelt sent off.

items.title: Man City latest: Injury concerns as Haaland and Semenyo hobble off
Fulham beat Hull to earn under-pressure Arbeloa a first PL win
items.description: Under-pressure Alvaro Arbeloa earned the first Premier League win of his managerial career as Fulham beat Hull City 1-0 at Craven Cottage to climb out of the relegation zone.

items.title: Chelsea's Martinez taken to hospital for 'precautionary tests'
items.description: Goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez was taken to hospital as Chelsea's 2-0 win at Everton on Saturday meant they secured their first clean sheet in nine months.
